value.rationale: An exact, natural complete classification of the three-variable logical expressive power for a unified family of finite linear spaces, including the surprising equivalence of geometries with 2 points/line to projective/affine spaces with q+1 points/line, of arbitrary q and dimension. The sharp 21-element representatives and rank-three to rank-four transition are reusable finite-model-theoretic invariants. This is not just a renaming of prior thick-only results.
